title: You've been using AI wrong this whole time #aitips  #claude  #chatgpt  #shorts
transcript: Should you switch from ChatGPT to Claude? This video should help you out. If you want help writing emails, use Claude. If you need to brainstorm new ideas, use ChatGPT. If you want to build workflows or automations, switch to Claude. If you want to generate images, stick with ChatGPT. If you want to build websites or apps, use Claude. If you want to do deep research, stay with ChatGPT. If you want to connect your AI to different apps and tools, use Claude. If you're using it for shopping, stay with ChatGPT. If you want to analyze large documents, use Claude. If you use voice mode often, stay with ChatGPT. At the end of the day, I still use both for different tasks because they're good at different things. However, some of the tools built in Claude, like Claude Co-work and Claude Code, can be really useful if you use them the right way. So, let me know which one you use and make sure to follow me because I post about both of them every single day.
